entities.summary: Alexander Tollmann was an Austrian geologist and politician associated with the United Greens of Austria. He specialized in the geology and tectonics of the Eastern Alps and was a prominent critic of nuclear energy. Alexander Tollmann was a scientists & inventors from Vienna (1928-06-27, Vienna–2007-08-08). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
